scope: Prospective computational confirmation after MP33 development; new chr22 loci. Controlled paired context simulation, not real-read validation B and not independent biological validation C.
selection: Isolated PASS biallelic indels length2-30, ACGT, minimum allele length1; 500bp flanks inside frozen2024 benchmark BED with no other VCF record. Rank SHA256 MP34_CHR22|position; first128 calibration, next256 test. If fewer384 eligible sites, stop and report insufficiency without relaxing selection.
sources: Reference/alternate with500bp flanks. Classifier uses canonical templates only. Nuisance stress adds SNP at event_start-25 and event_end+25 and GCA insertion before event_end+40, never supplied to classifier.
records: For each locus, 2 source alleles x3 geometries x2 replicates x3 regimes: baseline, shifted, nuisance. Generate a300-source-base noisy fragment and its nested150-source-base view from the SAME edit ledger. Short start: center=500-floor((150-event_length)/2), left_event_absent=501, right_event_absent=event_end-1-150. Long start=short_start-75.
score: Minimum unit edit distance over all positive template substrings; exact cap600; reject censored values. Truth and ledger used only for evaluation and invariant checks.
arms: For each length150/300 and each regime, absolute conformal allele sets at alpha0.05 versus prior paired absolute/relative rule at alpha/2 each. Matched regime calibration. Nuisance uses incomplete canonical catalogue even during calibration. 12 arms, all reported.
calibration: Whole-locus maximum true score across12 reads per regime/view; rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)). Absolute arm one gate; paired arm splits alpha equally. No tuning to test outputs.
primary: Baseline and shifted, compare absolute300 with absolute150; report block coverage, correct/wrong singletons, ambiguous/empty, and paired transitions. A descriptive success requires more correct singleton calls, no increase in wrong singletons and empirical block coverage>=0.95 in each primary regime. Passing is not a statistical proof of superiority or conditional coverage.
secondary: Compare absolute300 versus paired150 at fixed nominal block coverage; preserve all nuisance results and all geometry strata. No adverse stratum hidden by aggregate.
runtime: CPU; batches of32 loci, atomic per-locus checkpoint; calibration freeze before test. Persistent archive after each batch, source/hash bound resume. Initial pilot first32 calibration loci only for runtime/invariants, no parameter tuning. Maximum24h compute; report incomplete if exceeded.
next: B remains open until paired REAL-read context analysis. C requires current benchmark and documented independence from benchmark construction. Manuscripts private. D optional.
